requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles for the Magellan printer, supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink capacity, reduce frequency of replacement, and improve customer convenience for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank design, IDS compatibility, bottle manufacturing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must accept new NGB keyed bottles and achieve at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle size exceeding 8,000 pages yield in lab testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure spill-free reliability for new ink bottles and refilling process, including NOA-F with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is critical for user satisfaction and to minimize warranty claims due to ink spills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during normal bottle installation and use, as verified in user and factory testing.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to allow end users to replace the Print Head Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components without requiring service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs for customers and HP.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design, user documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F following instructions without special tools; verified by usability testing.

requirements.Title: 80K Page Warranty Life Goal
requirements.Description: Set a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer, including support for service parts post-80K life.
requirements.Rationale: Extending warranty life increases product value and competitiveness, particularly for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably for 80,000 pages under standard usage; service parts available for post-80K maintenance.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for New Components
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 factory line to accommodate NOA-F, add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and provide molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Factory readiness is essential for new product introduction and timely market launch.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines are updated and validated for new components before mass production.

requirements.Title: Platform Integration of 4 Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Optimizes ink flow, supports higher page yield, and aligns with new tank and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink delivery system passes flow and reliability tests with new routing and integration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management Adaptation
requirements.Description: Adapt service station aerosol management with spit platform changes to accommodate the new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures safe and clean operation, preventing aerosol ink contamination due to tank modifications.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No excessive aerosol ink detected in service station during endurance testing.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize printer size.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains usability and printer footprint with new, larger tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function smoothly and printer meets size optimization goals with tank installed.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and air management system to support new tank and ink bottle designs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and print quality, reduces startup failures, and supports higher ink capacities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm enables successful priming and air management in 99% of new units tested.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel and EPEAT3 Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets Blue Angel and EPEAT3 environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are necessary for market access and competitive differentiation, especially in Europe.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives Blue Angel and EPEAT3 certification before launch.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature on the printer lid for enhanced user interaction or security.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages existing technology for improved functionality or user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is functional and passes integration and user acceptance testing on the lid.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS, WorkFromHome, and Flexworker Services
requirements.Description: Enable printer integration with HP's Platform as a Service (PaaS), WorkFromHome, and Flexworker solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports modern work models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be provisioned and managed via PaaS, and is compatible with WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Provide advanced scan solution and manageability features for SMB customers, including integration with WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB and enterprise requirements for workflow and device management.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports scan workflows and is manageable via WJA, HPSM, and JAM tools.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased printer page life and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Supports the 80K page warranty life and reduces paper jams or wear-related issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path endures 80,000 pages with minimal jams or failures in testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part accessible via service centers after the printer reaches 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer lifespan and supports post-warranty service models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts post-80K pages as per service manual.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection in IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection in the ink delivery system, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, supports new bottle design, and prevents incorrect installation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes installation, leak, and mis-installation prevention tests in lab and pilot production.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Marconi Tux dASIC
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL and Marconi Tux dASIC components in the new printer platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven, reliable technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates correctly with reused components and passes all functional tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern wireless printing and connectivity features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer connects reliably to Wi-Fi networks using Stingray module in user and lab tests.

requirements.Title: Security with Gauss4.xx (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features in the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances device security to meet enterprise and SMB requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: HW and FW development, security certification
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes security audits and meets Gauss4.xx specification requirements.

requirements.Title: Support for 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (color graphic display) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and provides enhanced control and feedback.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display is operational and passes usability and durability tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the printer to ensure safe transport and delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and meets standard packaging requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes drop and vibration tests in EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB Portal and ECP Path
requirements.Description: Enable onboarding and management via SMB Portal and ECP (Enterprise Customer Portal) path.
requirements.Rationale: Improves manageability for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be onboarded and managed via SMB Portal and ECP with all required features functional.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a 2-year warranty life for the printer, aligned with the 80K page warranty goal.
requirements.Rationale: Increases customer confidence and competitiveness in SMB and enterprise segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer warranty policy specifies 2 years or 80K pages, whichever comes first, and is communicated to customers.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL)
requirements.Description: Achieve a print throughput of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL mode.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for SMB and enterprise users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25 ppm (standard) and 20 ppm (PDL) in independent performance testing.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Print Head Assembly (PHA) life is at least 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with product reliability goals and reduces frequency of service events.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA demonstrates 65,000-page life in accelerated life testing.
